name: Tidepool (demo)
description: A fictional swim school site bundled with QA to show every page state.
guidelines: Serif display headings with a system sans for controls.
One teal action color; white cards on a pale aqua canvas.
Every price and time is explicit.

findings.title: Reserve button sits beside the email field
findings.detail: At 1440 × 900 the Reserve lesson button renders to the right of the email input instead of below the form, so it reads as part of the email field.

findings.title: Time slots have no time zone
findings.detail: The slot grid lists 9:00 to 14:00 without a time zone or am/pm, so travelling families can book the wrong hour.
